}}'''Yakobin''', called ''The Undaunted'', was an ancient [[Arafel|Arafellin]] king.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Yakobin the Undaunted}}

== History ==
During Yakobin's reign, there were several occasions where his army would have to retreat back to the [[Silverwall Keeps]] to make a final stand.{{ref/book|13|42}}

== Trivia ==
* Yakobin is named for Matthew Yakobina, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
